name: loan_demo
description: Log in with the given username and password, open the Request Loan page, enter the loan amount and the down payment, select the funding account in the From Account dropdown, click Apply Now, and read the loan application status

approved_plan.goal: Log in with the given username and password, open the Request Loan page, enter the loan amount and the down payment, select the funding account in the From Account dropdown, click Apply Now, and read the loan application status

steps.intent: Log in with the supplied username and password and reach the Accounts Overview page
steps.action: Replay the parabank_login@1.0.0 fragment using the provided username and password

steps.intent: Navigate to the Request Loan page
steps.action: Click the 'Request Loan' link in the navigation menu
Locate the Loan Amount input field and type the value of loan_amount
Locate the Down Payment input field and type the value of down_payment

steps.intent: Select the funding account in the From Account dropdown
steps.action: Open the 'From Account' dropdown and select the option matching funding_account
Locate and capture the loan application status text displayed on the confirmation/result page

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username used to log in to ParaBank

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The password used to log in to ParaBank

parameters.name: down_payment
parameters.description: The down payment amount for the loan

parameters.name: funding_account
parameters.description: The account number to select in the From Account dropdown to fund the loan

approved_plan.success_signal: The loan application result page is displayed, showing a loan application status message (e.g. "Approved" or "Denied") under a heading such as "Loan Request Processed"

verification_problems: parameter 'funding_account' was planned as an input but no recorded step references it — it is frozen as a constant
hardening_rejected: s03_type: detector 'loan_amount_field_missing' rejected: 'Request Loan' is visible on the page the run just succeeded on, so it can never distinguish that outcome from a genuine one
s06_extract: detector 'loan_denied' rejected: 'Denied' is visible on the page the run just succeeded on, so it can never distinguish that outcome from a genuine one

success.description: Page state proving success: This is a fixed page heading rendered by the application every time a loan application is successfully submitted and evaluated, regardless of whether the loan is approved or denied. It confirms the flow reached its goal — the application was processed — without depending on any variable data values like the status, provider name, date, or account numbers.
